editorial:
Imagine waking up to find your entire life ruined over a mistake. You follow Łukasz, a guy who studied geography but can't find a job, who suddenly gets thrown into a nightmare. He is arrested for a robbery he didn't do, and since his alibi is pretty weak, the police don't believe him. Things go from bad to worse when the victim dies, turning a simple crime into a major tragedy. You will feel his panic as he gets thrown into a prison where the rules are brutal and strange. He ends up in a cell with the coded-message crowd, and you'll be rooting for him to survive the pressure.

The acting is top-notch and makes you feel every bit of the stress. The way the movie shows the secret language and social hierarchy of the inmates is really interesting and keeps you glued to the screen. It is a bit slow in some parts, but the tension makes up for it. If you enjoy gritty stories about survival, you should definitely check this out. For the best experience, try renting it on Apple TV or adding the 4K Blu-ray to your physical collection to catch all the raw detail of the prison sets.
endingExplained: The story wraps up with a shocking realization about the system. After fighting to survive the prison's cruel social rules, the truth finally comes out. You see that the evidence against Łukasz was flawed from the start. He eventually gets cleared of the charges, but he is not the same person. The ending shows that even though he is free, the trauma of the prison life changed him forever.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves stories about unfair justice and survival.
